title: runner.status.json: what the runner is playing now (unversioned)
description: <runtime>/runner.status.json, merged field by field (write_status) by play.py's runner (bg3harness.runner.state) and by the app (bg3play.adapters.harness_runner.write_status). A session is running while `session_ended` is null. Paths are absolute on the machine that wrote them; readers use only their file names. No `v` field yet, for the same reason as runner.json. Other keys are free.
